issues.problem: vadhrīn is "the emasculated" (English, gloss); "निर्बल" (weak) is an interpretation.
"धाराएँ" (streams) is an addition; the note even says "streams is not added" and the English has only "the heavenly unfailing ones".

summary: Reviewed 5 units. Total issues: 2 error, 7 minor (8 carry a machine patch). Errors: unit 2 adds "and" between the objects (and contradicts its own note about apposition); unit 4 Hindi adds "धाराएँ" although the note says streams is not added. Other issues are minor Hindi wording (जात = caste, उबलता, निर्बल, अटल), brahman rendered "sacred word", and a passive/active mismatch for rāta-havya in unit 1. Unit 5 is ok. No regrouping suggested.
